_comment: T-4372: CI fails if the tools/ suite EXECUTED fewer tests than executed_min or skipped (incl. xfail) more than skipped_max. Read by tools/check_suite_outcome_floor.py over the junit report. Lower executed_min / raise skipped_max ONLY in the PR that deliberately removes or skips tests, and update _provenance with the new observed counts; raise executed_min deliberately as tests are added (a ::warning:: fires once the slack exceeds 2 x ratchet_margin).

_provenance.source: CI-observed (T-4387), job 'tools suite (py<ver>)'. The matrix is 3.12 only on push/pull_request, and 3.11 + 3.12 on schedule/workflow_dispatch (ci.yml matrix conditional). py3.12 floor lines: run 36677579612 (#600) executed 12475 / skipped 377; run 36680758581 (#607) 12499 / 377; dispatch run 36685685124 on main @171bdbc0c 12517 / 377. All green, 0 failed.
_provenance.py311_leg: MEASURED: dispatch run 36685685124 attempt 2 (main @171bdbc0c) was green on both legs with the SAME floor line on each: executed 12517 / skipped 377 on py3.11 and py3.12. One baseline serves both legs. (Attempt 1's single 3.11 failure, test_wal_crash_poc proc.wait TimeoutExpired, was a load flake; orchestrator is filing it separately.)
_provenance.junit_vs_pytest: the floor counts unique (classname, name) pairs in the junit report, so its numbers run a little below pytest's summary (12517/377 vs pytest's 12520 passed/378 skipped on the same 3.12 job). Always compare against the floor line, never the pytest summary.
_provenance.variance: skipped is identical (377) across all three 3.12 runs; the executed deltas (+24, +18) are tests added between the runs, not run-to-run noise. CI-to-CI variance is effectively 0.
_provenance.margin: executed_min = 12517 - 30; skipped_max = 377 + 30; ratchet_margin = 30 (a ::warning:: fires at slack > 60). Right after a re-baseline the slack is 30, so a drop of MORE than 30 executed tests trips the floor. As tests are added the slack grows toward 2 x 30 before the warning asks for a ratchet, so the real catch window is a drop larger than 30 to 60 tests, depending on how recently it was ratcheted, and up to 60 only if the warning is acted on (it does not block, so an ignored warning lets the slack keep growing).
_provenance.data_driven_counts: some executed counts are parametrized over repo data (e.g. test_shell_suites.py runs one case per tools/test_*.sh; test_telegram_env_resolution.py one per RESOLVING_MODULES entry), so adding or deleting such data moves executed like adding or removing tests does. Treat a data-driven drop exactly as a removed test: lower executed_min in the PR that removes the data.
_provenance.rebaseline_triggers: re-measure from a CI floor line (not a local run) and update observed_* after: a setup-python version bump or a change of the runner's toolcache (e.g. a wipe that reinstalls a different patch release), a pytest or plugin upgrade (collection and junit changes), a change of the CI matrix legs, or new optional dependencies that un-skip tests. pyyaml/pytest/pytest-xdist are PINNED in ci.yml (T-4415), so a pytest or plugin upgrade arrives only through a PR that bumps the pin; re-check the floor line in that PR. T-4763: no tools test needs a secret any more (the codex-config fixtures read this repo's history, not a private clone over a read PAT), so a fork or Dependabot PR executes the same set; re-measure after T-4763 lands, since ~120 previously skipped tests (bridge, worker-isolation canary) now run on every runner.
_provenance.superseded: the T-4372 local-run baseline (12504/271, executed_min 12250, skipped_max 400, margin 250): its assumption that CI skips FEWER than local was wrong (CI skips 377 vs local 271).
_provenance.ratchet_procedure: Tests ADDED: when the ::warning:: fires (slack > 2 x ratchet_margin), raise executed_min to about executed - ratchet_margin in the same or a follow-up PR. Tests REMOVED or newly SKIPPED on purpose: lower executed_min / raise skipped_max in THAT PR, and update observed_* here, so the drop is visible in review. Never raise ratchet_margin to make a drop pass.
_provenance.ratchet_2026_09_30: T-4434: ratcheted executed_min 12487 -> 12683 (= 12713 - 30) from PR #620's floor line (CI run 36712413939, py3.12: executed 12713, skipped 377, 0 failed). The +196 executed since the baseline is today's merged tests (T-4385/4361/4389B/4393 and others), not a count shift: the pinned pytest/xdist/pyyaml (T-4415) equal what CI already had installed. skipped_max stays 407.
_provenance.skip_bump_2026_10_26: T-2916 (ORG-052 Unit 4b, PR #1289): skipped_max 407 -> 421, exactly the +14 delta from #1289's CI floor line ('skipped 421, over skipped_max=407'). The new skips are intended: the approver adapter's mcp-2.x runtime, packaging and private-bus tiers in tools/test_approval_mcp_adapter.py and the runtime tier of tools/test_harness_host_mcp_registration.py skip under CI's system python (mcp 1.30). They ran green in the hash-locked mcp-2.3.0 venv locally (implementer and independent reviewer). T-4858 is the plan to run them in the hash-locked CI job, which would let skipped_max drop back.
_provenance.skip_bump_t3421_2026_10_26: T-3421 (PR #1303): skipped_max 421 -> 422, the +1 from #1303's CI floor line ('skipped 422, over skipped_max=421'). Intended: test_t3421_the_ancestor_retired's mailbox_mcp recipient check skips when the mcp SDK is not importable in the tools-suite step, matching test_mailbox_mcp's existing skipUnless(_HAS_MCP) guard.
_provenance.t2918_skip_budget: T-2918 (ORG-052 Unit 6b re-scoped): skipped_max 422 -> 438 (re-based onto T-3421 #1303's 422), arithmetic 422 (main's base) + 15 (a) + 1 (b) = 438, measured, not estimated, in the closest CI-like run available locally (CI=1, system python, dbus-python made unimportable as on the runner, a non-/tmp --basetemp): `python3 -m pytest tools/germinate/host_substrate/tests tools/test_host_control_runtime_table.py tools/test_host_control_org052_privileged_gates.py` reports exactly 16 skipped, and those three paths are every test file T-2918 adds. (a) 15 disposable-host gate tests in tools/germinate/host_substrate/tests/test_gate_acceptance_sandbox.py (E17/E19/E20/E33/E34/E36, exact rollback, T-5510 retire rollback, run in a podman-unshare user-namespace sandbox): launcher.availability() turns them OFF whenever CI is set (GitHub Actions sets CI=true on every runner, self-hosted included), because the tier is a seat-host acceptance run and must not change what CI measures; they run green on the seat host. (b) 1 test, tools/test_host_control_org052_privileged_gates.py::test_e17_the_broker_method_table_takes_only_closed_handles_and_ids, which introspects the dbus-python method table and skips without dbus-python (CI installs only pyyaml/pytest/pytest-xdist). The always-on guards (conftest.py + test_real_host_guards.py) and the pure-unit T-5510 contract tests never skip. PR #1302's first CI run reported 438 skipped (+17) while those guard tests errored; one skip beyond (a)+(b) could not be attributed locally (no xdist here), so re-check this entry against the next CI floor line. executed_min is unchanged: T-2918 ADDS about 950 executed tests, so the ratchet ::warning:: will fire; raise executed_min from the next CI floor line per ratchet_procedure, not from a local run. Re-based: orchestrator's PR #1303 (8da05cbe9) raised the base 421 -> 422 before this merged, so this is 422 + 15 + 1 = 438 (both provenance keys kept). The '438 skipped' on #1302's first run was measured against the old 421 base.
_provenance.ratchet_2026_10_26: Ratcheted executed_min 12683 -> 22747 (= 22777 - 30) from PR #1302's floor line (CI on e6c756b2a, py3.12: executed 22777, skipped 438, 0 failed), which raised the slack-over-2x-margin warning. The +10094 since the 09-30 ratchet is tests merged in the month (control-plane, installer, host_control and germinate arcs), not a count shift. skipped_max stays 438.

Every other new T-2919 test (tools/test_host_control_telegram_ingress.py, incl. the in-process adapter tool-output canary) is stdlib-only and EXECUTES in both ci.yml and dbus-tiers. Measured on top of main's 438 (after T-2918 #1302 and T-3421) with CI=1 and dbus-python made unimportable (5 skipped); the four modified pre-existing test files skip identically on HEAD and main (66 each). executed_min is untouched. Confirm against the PR's CI floor line.
